## Second edition

Trevor Hastie, Robert Tibshirani, and Jerome Friedman (Springer, 2009), 763 pages.

The book develops the important ideas in statistical learning in a common conceptual framework, emphasizing concepts and examples. The second edition adds graphical models, random forests, ensemble methods, least-angle regression and lasso path algorithms, non-negative matrix factorization, spectral clustering, and methods for wide data.
